_comment: fleetdeck config. Everything identity-shaped lives here — no branding, hostname or launchd label is hardcoded in the servers. Change these, run ./install.sh, done.
_brand: Shown in the header and the PWA name. Keep it short; it is uppercased in the UI.
_machine: This machine's Tailscale MagicDNS name, e.g. studio.tailXXXX.ts.net. Leave EMPTY to resolve it from Tailscale at boot — which is what you want. Only set it if Tailscale is not installed and you are fronting the portal some other way.
_label_prefix: Reverse-domain prefix for this operator's own launchd jobs, e.g. com.acme. Used two ways: install.sh names the fleetdeck agents with it, and the portal strips it from agent tile names so the board reads 'backup-nightly' instead of 'com.acme.backup-nightly'.
_ports: portal = the launcher. chat = the tmux fleet chat. ttyd = chat's private terminal backend; it binds loopback only and is proxied under /t, never linked.

chat._exclude_sessions: tmux sessions to keep out of the hue rotation — typically one backing a plain ttyd terminal, which would otherwise fight the others for window size.

agents._actions: Adds run/stop buttons to every agent tile. This surface has NO password — the tailnet bind is the only boundary — so leaving this false keeps the portal strictly read-only. Turn it on only if every tailnet device is trusted to restart jobs. The POST route also refuses any label the scan did not discover.
agents._include: Substring match on the label. EMPTY = every non-vendor agent in ~/Library/LaunchAgents. Set to ["com.acme."] to show only this operator's own jobs.
agents._exclude: Substring match, applied after include. Use for noisy jobs the operator never acts on.
